requirements.text: As a website visitor, I want to submit personal data through the contact form only after explicit consent is given, so that my privacy is protected and the institute complies with data protection regulations.
requirements.rationale: The contact form collects personal data from visitors; consent is a regulatory requirement under GDPR-like laws.

requirements.text: The website must include a privacy notice explaining how personal data submitted via the contact form will be used, stored, and protected.
requirements.rationale: Transparency about data handling is required by privacy regulations; the contact form triggers data collection.

requirements.text: The contact form must implement measures to prevent unauthorized access to submitted personal data, such as encryption in transit and at rest.
requirements.rationale: Security controls are necessary to protect visitor personal data from breaches, as required by data protection laws.

requirements.text: As a website visitor, I want my submitted inquiry data to be retained only for as long as necessary to respond, after which it is securely deleted, so that my personal data is not kept indefinitely.
requirements.rationale: Data minimization and retention limits are core privacy principles; the system should enforce automatic deletion.

requirements.text: The system must log all submissions of the contact form for audit purposes, recording timestamp, submitted data fields, and whether consent was obtained.
requirements.rationale: An audit trail is needed to demonstrate compliance with data protection obligations during regulatory reviews.

requirements.text: The display of departmental email addresses must not expose any personal data beyond the email itself, and should be considered public information with no expectation of privacy.
requirements.rationale: Email addresses on a public website are not personal data in this context, but the system must avoid inadvertently revealing other personal details.

requirements.text: As a website visitor, I want to see direct email addresses for specific departments so that I can contact the relevant department directly for specific matters.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder requested direct email addresses for specific departments, and this was included in the user story summary.

requirements.text: As a website visitor, I want to view a list of available courses so that I can see what the institute offers.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly stated that listing available courses is a core requirement, and the analyst captured it as a user story.

requirements.text: As a website visitor, I want to use a general contact form for general inquiries so that I can submit inquiries.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder stated a preference for a general contact form, implying ease of use is a priority.

requirements.text: As a website visitor, I want the course listing to be simple and easy to scan so that I can quickly see what courses are available.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder repeatedly emphasized only needing to see available courses, indicating a preference for minimal, uncluttered presentation.
